confidence_policy.medium: 0.50 <= final_score < 0.78 or broad/case-ending but semantically valid
confidence_policy.no_link: no usable pozhppurai/kurippurai target, numeric/noise source, or final_score < 0.25

features.name: surface_token_overlap
features.description: Direct normalized token overlap between paadal span and target span.

features.name: char_ngram_overlap
features.description: Character n-gram similarity for sandhi-like and compound variants.

features.name: semantic_lexicon_score
features.description: Match from semantic lexicon families: deity, thalam, sacred object, theology, myth.

features.name: morphology_stem_score
features.description: Match after case suffix stripping, verb stem normalization, and compound segmentation.

features.name: shared_entity_anchor_score
features.description: Accepted or inferred shared anchors for deity, thalam, object, body part, myth event.

features.name: ontology_relation_score
features.description: Subject-relation-object cues such as Siva wears crescent, devotee worships Siva.

features.name: sequence_consistency_score
features.description: Global monotonic or reverse-order alignment coherence.

features.name: neighbor_anchor_score
features.description: Previous/next accepted links support the target location.

features.name: gold_pattern_similarity
features.description: Similarity to accepted_high_ready, v3 corrected usable, v4 gold seed examples.

features.name: target_granularity_score
features.description: Reward exact compact target spans; penalize whole paragraphs when shorter span exists.

features.name: field_preference_score
features.description: Pozhppurai preferred; kurippurai allowed when meaning is absent in pozhppurai.

penalties.name: order_only_penalty
penalties.condition: order score is the only supporting evidence

penalties.name: missing_entity_anchor_penalty
penalties.condition: no shared entity and no ontology relation cue

penalties.name: target_too_broad_penalty
penalties.condition: target token length/source token length > 3.0 and no explains_line

penalties.name: polysemy_without_context_penalty
penalties.condition: ambiguous term such as மதி/விடை/அரவு/அடி without disambiguating cue

penalties.name: empty_pozhippurai_penalty
penalties.condition: no usable pozhppurai and no kurippurai fallback

upgrade_rules_for_medium_confidence: If medium row matches a v4 gold pattern and relation cue score >= 0.35, upgrade to high.
If target field is kurippurai but exact gloss exists and pozhppurai lacks meaning, allow high but mark target_field_preference=kurippurai.
If case ending is the only mismatch and entity anchor is clear, upgrade low to medium or medium to high depending score.
If score is medium but best-second margin < 0.08, keep medium/low and add manual_review_required.
